articles.summary: At Ardmore, we believe great leadership starts with experience, integrity, and a willingness to evolve. Few embody that more clearly than Robert Gaina. From his early days at sea to his upcoming appointment as Chief Operating Officer in 2026, Robert’s journey is a powerful example of how Ardmore supports talent from within – enabling people Discover how Robert Gaina’s career with Ardmore Shipping has evolved from sea to senior leadership, reflecting the company’s culture of development, performance and progress.
articles.title: From bridge to boardroom: Robert Gaina’s journey at Ardmore
